answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The willow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the onyx. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
